features.title: Discovery skills to the skill grammar

features.evidence: anti-pattern-detection, business-model-canvas, domain-language-extraction, capability-discovery rewritten to the skill.spec grammar: description = capability + Use when + Do NOT use (naming core siblings), metadata.tier leaf, Operational boundary, Preconditions (capability-discovery), typed Input / Output Contract (outputs to .harness/specs/<slice-id>/anti-patterns.md, glossary.md, canvas.yaml, capability.md drafts), Execution Protocol steps with Action/Target/Assertion, Verification Gate (test -s/grep counts + negative check), Escalation Gate (HALT, Context -> Options -> Recommendation -> Decision Needed), Handoff & Convergence (anti-pattern <-redirect- glossary; canvas -> anti-pattern; capability-discovery -> domain-language-extraction, codebase-audit). Content of the skills-bloom contract kept. kit skills-lint --only <4 skills>: PASS (4 of 15); kit guidance: PASS.
